name: django_handshake
tagline_zh: 不用手写 CSRF、session 或 API 路由——一条 ping 让 Hermes Agent 在 Djan…
tagline_en: Skip CSRF, session, and route boilerplate—one ping registers your Hermes Agent in Django and opens two-way API.
desc_en: Pings the Django backend to register the Hermes Agent session and establish bidirectional API connectivity.
why_zh: 把「Agent 会话注册」做成显式握手协议，而非散落的配置项。你只管发 ping。
why_en: Turns session registration into an explicit handshake instead of scattered config—one ping pins session state and callback URL.
limit_zh: 只认 Django 项目且需已配好 ALLOWED_HOSTS 与 CSRF 豁免。
limit_en: Requires an existing Django project with ALLOWED_HOSTS and CSRF exemption set; no DRF token auth, no WebSockets. It stops after the.
title_en: Django backend handshake that registers Agent session
